item.text: Slide 4’s table header is currently `Table 1` through `Table 4`, so this is a narrow text replacement in `ppt/slides/slide4.xml`. I’ll patch the package and then verify the resulting slide XML contains `T1` through `T4`.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, tempfile, shutil, os
p=Path('/home/user/Desktop/33_1.pptx')
backup=p.with_suffix('.pptx.bak')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(p, backup)
repls={'Table 1':'T1','Table 2':'T2','Table 3':'T3','Table 4':'T4'}
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, dir=str(p.parent), suffix='.pptx') as tmp:
    tmp_path=Path(tmp.name)
with zipfile.ZipFile(p, 'r') as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data=zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename=='ppt/slides/slide4.xml':
            text=data.decode('utf-8')
            for old,new in repls.items():
                text=text.replace(f'<a:t>{old}</a:t>', f'<a:t>{new}</a:t>')
            data=text.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)
shutil.copystat(p, tmp_path)
os.replace(tmp_path, p)
print('updated', p)
print('backup', backup)
PY
